column1: The IASB issued amendments to the classification and measurement requirements of financial instruments in
response to feedback received as part of the post implementation review of IFRS 9. The amendments include a new
requirement to permit an entity to deem a financial liability that is settled using an electronic payment system to be
discharged before the settlement date if specified criteria are met; and provide clarifications regarding assessing
contractual cash flow characteristics of financial assets, including those with ESG-linked features, financial assets with
non-recourse features and investments in contractually linked instruments. The IASB also amended the disclosure
requirements relating to investments in equity instruments designated at fair value through other comprehensive
income and added disclosure requirements for financial instruments with contingent features that do not relate
directly to basic lending risks and costs. The amendments will be applied prospectively. The impact on the annual
